item.title: Callers to Washington hotline 'press 2' for Spanish and get accented AI English instead
item.description: The Washington Department of Licensing has apologized for an AI voice speaking English in a strong Spanish accent when callers requested automated service in Spanish, and is trying to fix the problem.

item.title: Owner of hospital staffing business used fake employee tax forms to sidestep IRS
item.description: The owner and president of several healthcare staffing companies was sentenced to prison on Thursday for failing to pay employment taxes to the IRS, authorities announced.

item.title: Serial bike thief sentenced for burglaries from Portland apartment buildings
item.description: Chris McGinnis was sentenced to 50 months in prison for stealing bikes from three different apartment buildings in Portland, Oregon.

item.title: City of Portland temporarily bans tear gas at ICE facility as leaders seek permanent change
item.description: The City of Portland is working to define a fee schedule and guidelines for detention facilities, such as the ICE building, to reduce the use of tear gas and protect Portlanders.

item.title: Battle Ground teacher reinstated after 'false allegations' of Charlie Kirk comments, union says
item.description: A Battle Ground teacher has been reinstated after it was determined "false allegations" led to her original firing, according to a union representing educators.

item.title: Washington fire battalion chief sentenced to 25 years for wife's strangulation death
item.description: Kevin West, the former fire chief of the Camas-Washougal Fire District, was sentenced to 25 years in prison for strangling his wife Marcelle "Marcy" West in January 2024.

item.title: Murder suspect jumps from 2nd story to flee from police prior to SE Portland arrest
item.description: Portland police have closed a residential area near Cesar Chavez Boulevard and Division Street as part of an ongoing investigation related to an arrest on Ivon Street.
